entries.en: Increased chance of taking enemy down when sliding (@#(43)＋@#(25)).
Picking up coins adds to your score.
Increases the healing effectiveness of food.

number of uses.
Reduces cooldown time in between using items.

temporarily increase your attack power upon successful block.
Grants a chance to automatically guard when attacked.
Press @#(25) after blocking an attack to counterattack and stun with your shield.
Grants a chance to reflect projectile weapons when guarding with your shield.
Call enemies' attention to yourself. Use the ##(ABILITY) item @#(36)%s.

A spinning attack with invincibility. Press @#(47)+@#(25) after a four-hit combo on the ground.

Increase the number of arrows you can carry.
Fire an arrow that produces a shockwave. Higher skill levels boost range and power.
